# LuckyRay native video runtime 1.9.10

This is a new local source build, not the old untraceable binary. It plays local
media through libmpv's public client API in the library and canvas. Original media
is not transcoded or modified. Shipping assets include complete corresponding
source snapshots, build instructions, license texts and application relink steps.

The exact DLL and every material file are bound in runtime-manifest.json.
The original October DLL audit remains historical and unresolved for that binary.
See BUILD-INFO.json, SOURCE-INDEX.json, LICENSES.md and RELINK.zh-CN.md.

This private acceptance delivery does not certify codec patent rights. No public
release, update-feed change or patent-license purchase is authorized here.
